newsitem.title: USA: NPC International completes Pizza Hut buy.
newsitem.headline: NPC International completes Pizza Hut buy.

text.p: NPC International Inc said Thursday it completed its previously announced purchase of 126 Pizza Hut restaurants from PepsiCo Inc's Pizza Hut Inc division for an undisclosed price.
The company said the acquisition was funded through a newly established $175-million revolving credit facility.
In January, PepsiCo announced plans to spin off its restaurants to shareholders by the end of the year.

NPC is the world's largest Pizza Hut franchisee with 544 restaurants and delivery kitchens in 14 states. The company also operates and franchises 182 Tony Roma's restaurants and the theme restaurant Famous For Ribs.
Its shares closed off 1/8 Thursday at 10-1/4.
